checks: Parsed the 16 point and normal rows from the frozen proof and recomputed all 240 off-diagonal dot products. The listed minimum gaps agree and are all positive, making each point a strict exposed vertex.
Recomputed the four-row determinant by the permutation formula and obtained −11. Direct coordinate reduction modulo two yields every element of {0,1}^4 exactly once.

Enumerated all 432 integer points of the stated coordinate box against the seven displayed inequalities. Exactly the 16 vertices survive. Independently evaluated the floor/ceiling interval formula at all 72 integer triples; it gives the same census, with the same pairs in each of the 12 (x,y) rows.
The seven inequalities are used only as valid inequalities for the hull; the lattice-point exclusion does not require them to be the complete facet list.

The first-coordinate width is 2. A lattice functional of width at most one has c_i=t+epsilon_i at the four standard basis vertices. At (2,2,3,5) the value is 12t plus a subset sum, and subtracting t gives the displayed 11t condition. The subset sums are {0,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12}. Only t=0 with all zeros or t=−1 with all ones is possible, both giving the zero functional.

Verified the two original source file digests. The primary source §§1–3 contains the identical exposed points, compact emptiness certificate and width check; the earlier archive §§1–2 gives the same vertices and width condition with a different emptiness certificate.

overlap.comparison: Exclusive facet witnesses of a full-dimensional lattice-free polyhedron form an empty vertex set with distinct parities. This antecedent supplies a parity upper bound but does not produce a parity-saturated hull of width two.

Concerns width-two exclusions for a three-point extreme segment and related lattice-area constraints. It neither gives this four-dimensional saturated vertex set nor asserts a width-one classification.

readability: The width proof tests five listed vertices; its exclusion applies to every nonzero integer covector, including nonprimitive ones.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The exact listed construction is full-dimensional, parity-saturated, empty, and of lattice width two.
